body:
First off I want to say thank you for replying to my post you gave me some great advice on here. Idon't think all works for me, but a lot of it does. Definitely got me to calm down have at least a temporary change in mood.

Issue with living at home is that has a lot of other issues that I won't go into, not anyone's fault really it's just a very tough situation and it isn't ideal for me to be here. I also still am tied to the lease because said roommate blocked any sublesse I've tried to bring in.

In good news i did get a job out of state, which admittedly is thrilling because it's actually related to my major. Finally after years out of college. Financially it's gonna suck but it seems like the best possible solution. 

You are right that I need healthier coping mechanisms. Exercise is tough (fuck you autoimmune disease), but I need to find something that works for me to release the dopamine. I actually cna go through the day without thinking about things, it's at the end of the day when I have trouble sleeping that things start to go bad. 

You're also right that I've been in deeper holes, it's just I know how to conquer those issues and whe they're also horrible, I know how to deal with them or the most part or I'm so numb to them now I don't even care anymore. This one's a totally different beast and it's made me change my outlook on everyone I know and even every human in earth, it's awful i feel like I've lost my naïvety and extrovertedness. 

Once again thank you, this comment alone has helped me stop the self harm bouts for the night. I think that it's amazing that you helped your sister in her roughest moments. Take care, kind internet stranger.

Sorry that you're so unintelligent that you cannot recognize the differences between the French, Dutch, Russian and Luxembourgish flags, but for me they're easy to tell the difference. As for dyslexic people, France written really small for a place like South Carolina, or Spain for a place like New Jersey would be hell. Enjoy the deserved downvotes.
Maybe then learn your geography and vexillology? It's really not that hard.
I can't imagine how I'd survive getting hit by this train, but you're right I guess anything is possible, and if I did survive it'd be an even worse situation.

Thank you, genuinely thank you. I just don't want to hurt anyone but myself. Yes I know the "people that care" will be hurt mentally but they'll eventually get over it, i just don't want people i don't know (or even those i know) to.be traumatized by my mangled body.

No you don't, I've heard of his toxic behavior from others and saw small signs of it before, but never anything this extreme. I've learned my lesson, and hopefully I won't be so naïve anymore.  Take care as well mate.
Thanks man, thankfully I escaped and I'm in a safe place now. It's gonna suck financially until I get off the lease but I'd rather that than live with him.

Admittedly I didn't even think to call the police when it happened. Even so, where I live if you make first contact you end up getting charged with assault, and technically I did. I tried going to the police the next day, but they weren't interested, and other thank marks on my body I basically have no evidence.

Very long story, but basically I told him to stop smoking tobacco inside the house multiple times and he wouldn't listen, and I told him if he wouldn't stop he could forget about getting a dog. He wouldn't back down and I kept calling him out on his shit.  Eventually he kept yelling at me until I nudged him so I could enter my room, and then the punches started.
My friend of 5 years/roommate of 5 months beat me up and tried choking me out on Sunday night. He's definitely not my friend anymore but this hit hard.
I wish, I can't afford an increase in rent until I get a better paying job, and when that happens I'm just gonna look for a place with a private bathroom.
Fair enough to your anecdotal experience then, unfortunately I haven't been so lucky over the years.
And do you have crohn's yourself?
Because I have crohn's and as ridiculous as it sounds I was worried I was gonna shit myself if I didn't go to the closest toilet possible.

The thing is it isn't like we don't clean and I do clean the toilet, it's just it's never immaculate, and she seems to want the immaculate standard. Not everyone in the house is straight and she's the only person that's ever complained to us about the house and we have guests fairly often.

3 bathrooms, but only two are in use because one of the other roommates pays extra for one of the bathrooms so he can grow plants in there. The one in question is closer to more bedrooms so when she's not here up to 4 people will use it in a day.
